thread:
harper: Scanner flagged libxyz in host-agent (2.4.0) as CVE-2026-12345. RCE vector via metadata parsing.

liam: Confirmed PoC. Affects DaemonSet with hostPath and hostNetwork true.

nina: Important dependency: agent requests KMS signing for node attestations. Rolling restarts could impact attestation flow for customers using HSM-bound keys.

harper: Short plan: build patched 2.4.2, validate in staging, then canary restart 10% nodes -> full roll. If active exploit detected, cordon+drain affected nodes.

ops-bot: Suggest adding a Calico GNP to restrict host-agent egress to only keystore CIDRs and internal ranges before rollout. Deploy to canary pools first.

liam: Draft RBAC change: remove cluster-admin binding from agent SA; provide get/list/watch on pods/nodes, patch leases, create events, create CSR. No clusterrolebinding to cluster-admin.

sec-oncall: IR checklist: revoke bootstrap tokens, enable egress denylist, increase log retention for agent logs for 90d, notify SOC.

nina: For keystore continuity: issue a short-lived delegation key (72h) signed by HSM so agents can re-attest during restarts. Revoke after rollout and reject deprecated delegation keys in keystore proxy.

harper: I'll open PRs for image bump, GNP, and RBAC tightening. Tagging action owners in ticket.

liam: Post-rollout: run controlled PoC in sandbox to verify mitigation and collect audit artifacts (image digest, node kernel, agent logs).

harper: Timeline: T0 report, T+3h staging, T+8h canary, T+36h full. Postmortem owners: harper + nina.
